text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"The observed QA accuracy drop after the store exceeds ~40 items is caused by token‑budget‑induced context interference, and it will be mitigated by periodically consolidating (rewriting) the stored context into a summary, as described in the consolidation paper and the recent arXiv technique.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["81d02abc","f1bc2caa","17d25ddc","5beb6fb6"],"tags":["interference","consolidation","token_budget","accuracy_drop"]},{"statement":"The rewrite‑based ablation outperforms naive append because it implicitly compresses the context, thereby reducing token consumption and preventing budget overruns; consequently, the rewrite method should stay within the daily token budget beyond day 20 where the append method exceeds it.","confidence":0.71,"support_ids":["5beb6fb6","f1bc2caa","b9cd6a13"],"tags":["ablation","compression","token_budget","rewrite_vs_append"]}]}
